budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: BFCOL-3 10-17: successor of lane4b (gate PASS, coordinator CHANGES_REQUESTED 11:35: one 6,214-sink root, boundary insertion 212-245 ps TT). Measured lane4b tree: 4 BUFx24 levels to the 136 ICG clones (149 ps), ICG 24 ps, 2 levels below (56 ps); the 326 pin flops on the W/E faces hung off the same balanced tree as the 5.9k lane flops between them. Structural fix: regional same-PLL phase-0 roots, each beside its pin-flop mass -- fclk_i (W pin root: BXST boundary stage + every ze_d/rst_pin capture register), fclk (lane root: 4 gated lanes), fclk_o (E pin root: registered output stage); every input pin is captured on fclk_i only and every output pin launched on fclk_o only. RTL ot_v41_bf_lane4r_cl = ot_v41_bf_lane4_cl with only register clock nets changed (parent ties the three roots to the band's leaf clock); same 164.16 x 48.6 band x4 in the lane slot. r2: multiple_cts_roots runs TritonCTS with -clk_nets on the three roots only, so the 130 ICG clones' gated nets got no tree (r1: ICGx1 driving 46 flops unbuffered, 355 ps slew, lane root 242-292 ps, E root 163-175 ps): ICG clones of <=16 sinks (OT_CG_K=16) so each clone drives its flops directly.
